# Salt & Syntax

> 1-on-1 online lessons in Croatian, English and German for adults and kids, taught by Marina Toto, a native Croatian tutor based in Kastav near Rijeka, Croatia. Every new student starts with a free 30-minute trial lesson.

## About the tutor

- Marina Toto, native Croatian speaker, lives in Kastav, a medieval hilltop town near Rijeka, Croatia.
- MA in Sociology; lessons use TESOL methodology.
- 15 years of project management experience, including 8 years in Berlin's tech industry, working in German and English as a solution engineer and IT project manager for enterprise clients.
- Speaks six languages: Croatian (native), English (C2), German (C1, telc-certified), Slovenian, Italian and Spanish.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/marina-toto/

## Who the lessons are for

- Croatian: foreigners living in Croatia, partners of Croatians who want to talk to the family and friends, people with a holiday home in Croatia, and children of Croatian families abroad. Lessons can be taught in English or German.
- English and German: adults and kids learning for work, school, exams or a move abroad, including school tutoring for Croatian children.

## How lessons work

- Always 1-on-1, online via Zoom or Google Meet.
- 60-minute lessons, or 45 minutes (recommended for younger learners).
- Flexible scheduling: mornings, afternoons and evenings, weekdays and weekends.
- All materials are prepared by the tutor; nothing to buy.
- Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours in advance.

## Prices (EUR)

- Free trial lesson: 30 minutes, €0, no card needed.
- Pay as you go: €25 per 60-minute lesson (45 minutes: €20).
- Monthly pack: €80 for 4 lessons per month (45 minutes: €60).
- Intensive: €140 for 8 lessons per month (45 minutes: €105).
